android.desc:
Stay Focused is the app blocker, pomodoro study timer and screen time control that actually works. Add Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Shorts, Reels, or any distracting app to your blocklist, set a schedule, turn on Strict Mode — and reduce screen time 47% in the first week. Set a daily app limit for every app, block distracting websites, and run a study timer that holds the line. Trusted by 5M+ Android users to stop phone addiction and rebuild focus.

📉 47% less screen time in the first week
⏳ ~2 hours saved every day on average
🔒 94% of Strict Mode users stick with it

🎯 Why Stay Focused
Most blocking apps give you an easy "off" button. Stay Focused adds friction — no shortcuts, no "just this once." That's why users beat phone addiction, boost productivity, and come back every day for screen time control, pomodoro study sessions and a real digital detox.

⚙️ Core features
• App Blocker — block Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, games, or any distracting app in seconds
• Website Blocker — block websites and URLs across supported browsers
• Study Timer & Pomodoro Timer — 25/5 pomodoro study sessions with automatic app blocking, built for exam prep and deep learning
• Focus Sounds — calming ambient sounds during a focus session
• Location Blocking — block apps and sites automatically at places you choose, like school or the office
• Screen Time Control & App Limiter — see and limit screen time per app, with a daily app limit
• Digital Detox — scheduled phone-free hours to reset your screen time
• Strict Alarm — an advanced alarm that keeps ringing until you solve a challenge, so you actually get up
• Shorts Blocker — block YouTube Shorts before the algorithm eats your day
• Reels Blocker — block Reels on Instagram and Facebook at the source
• Adult Content Blocker — filter harmful sites and keywords automatically for safer browsing
• Screen Time Tracker & App Usage Tracker — see which apps eat your day and limit app usage
• Self Control mode — Strict Mode helps lock your blocklist so you're not one tap from breaking focus
• Keyword Blocker — filter content by keyword, not just by app
• Custom Schedules & Timers — auto-block during work hours, class, or family time
• Notification Blocker — silence alerts during focus sessions
• Distraction Blocker & Social Media Limiter — one-tap focus mode across apps, sites and social feeds

👥 Built for
📚 Students — a pomodoro study timer with automatic app blocking for exam prep and deep learning. Start

quotes.text: Android P just provides this functionality out of the box. Anybody else can download these features from the Play Store today. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.stayfocused
quotes.story_title: iOS 12 introduces new features to reduce interruptions and manage Screen Time
